name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; 'blit_scaled_chapter_pose' accurately captures the purpose (nearest-neighbour scaled blit of a chapter character pose into the 320x200 working surface). All 4 callers (fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro @0x2D093, fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main @0x2E341, typeB @0x2FC85, typeC @0x3072F) use it exactly for the chapter intro/outro pose zoom animation. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Software nearest-neighbour scaler: rasterize a 320x200 source bitmap into the full 320x200 working surface, centred on a fixed-point source coordinate, with a per-pixel source step controlling zoom. Drives the chapter intro/outro character-pose zoom animation.
logic_summary: Clears the destination surface (data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr) to 0 via memset(...,64000). Derives top-left source coords from centre minus step*half-extent: src_x_fp = src_cx + scale_fp_step*-0xA0 (160 cols), src_y_fp = src_cy + scale_fp_step*-0x64 (100 rows). Iterates 200 dest rows x 0x140 (320) dest cols; for each output pixel whose fixed source coord is in bounds ([0,0xA000) X, [0,0x6400) Y) it picks the source byte at src_bitmap + (src_y_fp/128)*0x140 + (src_x_fp/128) (signed /128 strips the 7-bit fraction). Source coords advance by scale_fp_step per col/row; out_row_ptr advances 0x140 per row. Out-of-bounds output pixels keep the memset-cleared background. scale_fp_step < 0x80 magnifies, > 0x80 shrinks.
signature: void fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose(uint32 src_cx, uint32 src_cy, uint32 src_bitmap, int32 scale_fp_step)

params.name: src_cx
params.semantics: Screen-centre source X in 7-bit fixed-point; the scaled image is centred horizontally on this source coordinate. Caller passes ((row_table-bias)*i/10)*0x80 + 0x5000.
params.reason: Accurate fixed-point centre-X name; matches body use src_x_fp_start = src_cx + scale_fp_step*-0xA0 and caller-supplied centre coordinate. No address residue.

params.name: src_cy
params.semantics: Screen-centre source Y in 7-bit fixed-point; the scaled image is centred vertically on this source coordinate. Caller passes ((col_table-bias)*i/10)*0x80 + 0x3200.
params.reason: Accurate fixed-point centre-Y name; matches body use src_y_fp = src_cy + scale_fp_step*-0x64. No address residue.

params.name: src_bitmap
params.semantics: Linear base address of the 320x200 1-byte-per-pixel source bitmap (row stride 0x140). Caller passes the malloc'd VGA backup buffer (pose_bitmap).
params.reason: Accurate; used directly as the source pixel base (src_bitmap + (src_y/128)*0x140 + src_x/128). No address residue.

params.name: scale_fp_step
params.semantics: Per-output-pixel source step in 7-bit fixed-point (the zoom factor): 0x80 = 1:1, < 0x80 magnifies, > 0x80 shrinks. Caller passes 0x80 - i*9 across the 10/11 animation frames.
params.reason: Accurate scale-step name. NOTE: the Ghidra decompiler labels this 4th param internally as 'src_cx_fp', which is misleading -- but the src/-declared name scale_fp_step is correct and is what the refine judges. No address residue. No rename.

returns.semantics: No return value; result is written into the global working surface data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr.

notes: Source comment block (blittile.c lines 239-282) is already precise and complete: purpose, 7-bit fixed-point coordinate format, top-left = centre - step*half-extent derivation (0xA0 cols / 0x64 rows), globals, and the verified /128-vs->>7 timing rationale (signed divide-by-128 must be preserved or the per-frame pose-zoom shortens below the ~0.9s footstep SFX -> shop-greeting typewriter SFX cuts it off; commit a195696 / project_layer2_codegen_timing_hot_loops). Kept comment as-is. Ghidra plate is consistent with this understanding (no contradiction), so plate left untouched. Callers confirm arg1/arg2 = screen-centre X/Y fixed-point (the caller's NOTE re the row/column table feeding X/Y is just an apparent swap in the upstream table indexing, not a defect in this function), arg3 = source bitmap, arg4 = shrinking scale step (0x80 - i*9). Only my own shard staged; pre-existing modified shards for other addresses left untouched; blittile.c not edited (comment_verdict=keep).
